tidal.midnightconfig.title: Tidal Config
tidal.midnightconfig.reloadReminder: You may need to reload your chunks for changes to take affect!
tidal.midnightconfig.chunkRadius.tooltip: The chunk radius of chunks that should spawn waves. Reduce this number if your struggling for performance!
tidal.midnightconfig.chunkUpdatesRescanA: The amount of block updates that should happen in a chunk before it is rescanned for wave spawning.
tidal.midnightconfig.maxRenderY.tooltip: Waves, wet overlays, and splash particles at or above this Y coordinate will not be rendered. Keep the default to disable culling.
tidal.midnightconfig.wetShaderMode.toolt: AUTO detects Iris shaders automatically and picks the matching opacity below. Use FORCE_ON / FORCE_OFF if detection is wrong.
tidal.midnightconfig.wetRed.tooltip: Red channel (0-255) of the wet sand tint.
tidal.midnightconfig.wetGreen.tooltip: Green channel (0-255) of the wet sand tint.
tidal.midnightconfig.wetBlue.tooltip: Blue channel (0-255) of the wet sand tint.
tidal.midnightconfig.wetAlpha.tooltip: How opaque the wet sand looks WITHOUT shaders (0-255). Vanilla blends the dither, so this needs to be high. Lower = more transparent.
tidal.midnightconfig.wetAlphaShader.tool: How opaque the wet sand looks WITH Iris shaders (0-255). Lower = more transparent (more sand shows through the dither).
tidal.midnightconfig.wetUseWorldLight.to: Light the wet overlay by the real world light (recommended). Disable to use the legacy fully-dark light for comparison.
tidal.midnightconfig.debug.tooltip: Helpful for figuring out where waves are spawning, and how.
tidal.midnightconfig.debugDocsSite: - Green particles are SitePos', they should only spawn along shore
tidal.midnightconfig.debugDocsSpyglassHo: - Spyglass in hotbar to see all scanned water blocks, color coded per closest SitePos
tidal.midnightconfig.debugDocsSpyglass: - Hold spyglass to see debug waves on wave spawn
tidal.midnightconfig.debugDocsClock: - Hold compass to see wave directions for current chunk, offhand to for all nearby chunks
tidal.midnightconfig.debugDocsCompass: - Offhand clock to see spawning positions of waves
